command_rows.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md; sed -n '1,240p' tools/audit-cache.py; sed -n '1,120p' analysis/cache.sha256; sed -n '1,120p' .gitignore"

/bin/bash -lc 'stat cache/vendor-snapshot.bin analysis/cache.sha256 tools/audit-cache.py README.md; file cache/vendor-snapshot.bin; sha256sum cache/vendor-snapshot.bin; getfattr -d -m- cache/vendor-snapshot.bin 2>&1 || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git ls-files --stage; git fsck --full --no-reflogs --unreachable 2>&1; git reflog show --all --date=iso'

/bin/bash -lc "xxd -g1 cache/vendor-snapshot.bin; ls -laR --time-style=full-iso; lsattr cache/vendor-snapshot.bin analysis/cache.sha256 2>&1; findmnt -T cache/vendor-snapshot.bin -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS; command -v ausearch || true; command -v debugfs || true; rg -uuu -n -F 'vendor-snapshot.bin' . .. 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os
for p in ['cache/vendor-snapshot.bin','analysis/cache.sha256']:
 print(p, os.listxattr(p))
 for n in os.listxattr(p):
  print(n, repr(os.getxattr(p,n)))
PY
find /var/log/audit /var/lib -maxdepth 3 \\( -iname '*audit*' -o -iname '*provenance*' -o -iname '*trace*' \\) -print 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'
find .. -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f %y\\n'
"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /home/ftmon/.bash_history /home/ftmon/.zsh_history /root/.bash_history; do if [ -r "$f" ]; then echo "$f"; rg -n -F '"'vendor-snapshot.bin' \""'$f" || true; rg -n -F '"'audit-cache.py' \""'$f" || true; fi; done
ls -l /var/log/audit/audit.log /var/account/pacct /var/log/account/pacct 2>/dev/null || true
journalctl --since '"'2026-09-29 12:56:00' --until '2026-09-29 12:59:00' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | rg -n 'vendor-snapshot|audit-cache|case06' || true
git check-ignore -v cache/vendor-snapshot.bin analysis/cache.sha256
git log --all --full-history -- cache/vendor-snapshot.bin analysis/cache.sha256
"
